description.value: Twisted Hills Craft Cider is the first standalone cidery in the Similkameen Valley, established in 2012 in Cawston and producing BC's first full line-up of certified organic ciders from estate-grown, cider-specific apple varieties. The cidery operates a seasonal tasting room—dubbed the CiderDome—on a 12-acre organic orchard where visitors can taste a diverse range of single-varietal and fruit-infused ciders. Touring cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (HWY 3) can stop in to sample and purchase bottles directly, or arrange curbside pickup of online orders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active seasonal tasting room and online store in Cawston, BC. The OSM phone and website match the website exactly; the website supplies a fuller address (city and postal code) consistent with the OSM street number, and HWY 3 and Crowsnest Highway are the same road. Washrooms are confirmed indirectly by the tasting room associate job posting, which lists cleaning washrooms as a staff duty, indicating on-site customer-accessible facilities; no explicit evidence of bike parking, water refill, or most optional amenities was found.
concerns: OSM address omits city and postal code; website provides '2070 HWY 3 CAWSTON, British Columbia V0X 1C2'. HWY 3 and Crowsnest Highway are the same road — no true discrepancy, just incomplete OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible tasting room and online store on the Crowsnest Highway (HWY 3) in Cawston. A useful and distinctive stop for touring cyclists passing through the Similkameen Valley.
